name: Tuurbo – Performance & SEO Connector
author: Tuurbo.ai

sections.description:
Tuurbo Connector links your WordPress or WooCommerce website to the Tuurbo.ai platform.

Use it to authenticate your site, sync your content structure (pages and articles), and enable Tuurbo.ai workflows built for SEO, Core Web Vitals and site performance, UX and accessibility.

This plugin is designed for teams that want a lightweight and reliable integration layer between WordPress and Tuurbo.ai.

What you can do with Tuurbo Connector

  • Connect your WordPress website to your Tuurbo account instead of custom manual integrations
  • Connect WooCommerce stores and sync products, categories, and key page data
  • Prepare your site for Tuurbo optimization workflows
  • Manage connection status and integration settings from WordPress
  • Publish SEO/AEO-ready articles and optimize SEO tags through Tuurbo Automation

Why site owners use Tuurbo Connector

  • Reduce setup friction for all the Tuurbo AI automation workflows
  • Support WordPress and WooCommerce websites from one platform
  • Give marketing and technical teams a cleaner integration flow
  • Centralize connection and sync settings inside WordPress
  • Start from a lightweight plugin layer instead of a custom integration

Who this plugin is for

  • WooCommerce store owners
  • Marketing teams working on SEO and site performance
  • Agencies managing WordPress and eCommerce websites
  • Teams already using Tuurbo as their optimization platform

A Tuurbo.ai account is required to use this plugin.

External services

This plugin connects to the Tuurbo platform, a third-party service required for the plugin to function. The plugin communicates with the following Tuurbo services:

  • suite.tuurbo.ai — the Tuurbo platform where your connected website is managed
  • edge.tuurbo.ai — receives connection data when the plugin is activated and authenticated
  • cdn.tuurbo.ai — serves the Tuurbo embed script injected into your site’s pages (only when explicitly enabled from the Tuurbo dashboard)

By installing and activating this plugin, you authorize Tuurbo to access your site data as described in the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

The following data is sent to edge.tuurbo.ai every time a connection is established or refreshed:

  • Site URL and title
  • WordPress version, locale, and timezone
  • A secure API token used to authenticate subsequent requests
  • WooCommerce version and API credentials (only if WooCommerce is active on your site)

No visitor data or personal information is ever transmitted. No data is collected without explicit activation by the site owner.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through the WordPress plugins store.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Start using your connected website inside the Tuurbo platform.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Tuurbo account?

Yes. This plugin connects your WordPress or WooCommerce website to the Tuurbo platform, so an active Tuurbo account is required.

Does this plugin work with WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin supports WooCommerce websites in addition to standard WordPress installs.

Can I connect a staging site first?

Yes. Using a staging or test environment before production is recommended.

Does this plugin replace my SEO plugin?

No. Tuurbo Connector is an integration plugin. It connects your website to Tuurbo and does not aim to replace every SEO or performance plugin you may already use.

Does the plugin edit my theme files directly?

The connector is designed to connect your website with Tuurbo and handle integration settings from WordPress. It does not require manual edits to your theme files during setup.

Does it work with page builders?

It is designed to work with standard WordPress websites, including WooCommerce-based setups. Compatibility should always be validated on your specific stack.

Does this plugin send data to an external service?

Yes. This plugin connects to Tuurbo services in order to authenticate your website and enable platform features.

What data is sent to Tuurbo?

The plugin sends your site URL, WordPress version, locale, timezone, and API credentials required to authenticate the connection. If WooCommerce is active, it also sends WooCommerce version and API credentials to enable store synchronization. No visitor data or personal information is ever transmitted.

Can I disconnect the website later?

Yes. You can disconnect the integration from the plugin settings or from your Tuurbo account, depending on your configuration.

Is WooCommerce required?

No. WooCommerce is optional. The plugin can also be used on standard WordPress websites.
